system.title: System Information
dashboard.memory.label: GPU Memory Request
dashboard.support.recovery_hold: This VM has an unresolved operation. Review recovery before changing GPU support.
operations.plan.progress_body: Checking the selected VM, GPU, settings and recorded setup for this request. Current driver files are authenticated before effects; setup and repair checks can take several minutes. Successful preparation continues directly into execution. Cancel keeps your draft and abandons only the read-only preparation.
operations.help.body: Select a real VM and physical GPU, enable GPU support in the draft and choose a VRAM request from 1 GB to the detected card capacity. Use the toggle or More actions > Remove GPU support to disable support. Advanced Allocation retains exact VRAM triples; saved Compute/Encode/Decode requests are preserved. Apply, Verify, Repair / Reinstall, removal and Delete profile proceed directly after fresh checks, without a review dialog or second confirmation. Selecting an action authorizes its required VM power transitions. First setup obtains permission and reads it back before preparing GPU changes. Windows credential and UAC prompts remain separate. Settings are saved only after the required outcome checks pass. Failed saving permits a save-only retry; uncertain operations require explicit reconciliation. Delete profile removes only this VM's app settings, pairing, history and recovery records; it never changes VM power, GPU attachment or guest files. GPU replacement remains unavailable.
operations.enrollment.review.title: Checking GPU management permission
operations.verify.consent.unknown: Power state is unknown. Refresh before trying again.
operations.verify.consent.off: This action includes temporarily starting this VM, then gracefully shutting it down to Off.
dashboard.setup.body: GPU support is not enabled on this VM. Start GPU setup to enable it. Retained driver preparation is checked before deciding whether installation is required.
operations.inventory.refresh_failed: Could not load VM and GPU information. Inspect diagnostics for the cause, then use Refresh to retry. Any previous rows are historical.
dashboard.support.unattached: GPU support is not enabled on this VM. Start GPU setup to enable it.
dashboard.memory.advanced_hint: Exact VRAM request for compatibility with saved settings. Minimum ≤ Optimal ≤ Maximum, in native bytes. Default placeholders are suggestions. Editing an empty group fills its other defaults. Clear all three fields for no explicit write. Use the GPU support toggle or Remove GPU support to disable support.
